title: Lemony Corn and Cabbage Wrap
description: A fresh and healthy wrap filled with sautéed corn, cabbage, and a hint of lemon.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the corn and cabbage to the skillet and sauté for 3-4 minutes.
Add a squeeze of lemon juice and cook for an additional minute.
Warm the wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spooning the corn and cabbage mixture onto the center of the wrap.
Top with additional shredded cabbage and a sprinkle of lemon zest.
Serve immediately and garnish with shredded husk.
